name: Harborline Freight
about: Harborline Freight runs mid-size container trucking between the port and inland warehouses. They quote most jobs by email and track shipments in a mix of spreadsheets and a legacy TMS.

signals.text: Hiring two operations coordinators to handle quote requests and shipment status emails.
Post from the COO: quote turnaround slipped to 26 hours during peak season.
Customers can request a quote through a web form that goes to a shared inbox.
Opened a second depot in Venlo this spring and plans to add 30 trucks.

name: Brightpath Clinics
about: Brightpath Clinics is a group of four physiotherapy clinics. Patients book by phone or through an online form, and front desk staff copy intake details into the practice management system by hand.

signals.text: Several patient reviews mention long hold times when calling to book.
Looking for a part-time front desk assistant for data entry and appointment reminders.
Opening a fifth clinic in Round Rock next quarter.

name: Ledgerleaf
about: Ledgerleaf sells bookkeeping software to small agencies. The support team of three answers tickets in a shared help desk and writes most replies from scratch.

signals.text: Two incidents last month related to bank sync delays.
Hiring a support engineer; the posting mentions 400 tickets a week.
Shipped multi-currency invoices, with a note that docs are still in progress.

name: Northwind Outdoor
about: Northwind Outdoor sells camping gear online through its own store and two marketplaces. Product data is edited separately in each channel.

signals.text: Some products show different prices and stock levels across channels.
Hiring a catalog assistant to keep listings in sync.
Launched a rental program for tents and packs this summer.

name: Quillstone Legal
about: Quillstone Legal is a commercial law firm. New client intake runs through email and a conflict check that paralegals do manually against an internal list.

signals.text: Hiring a paralegal focused on client onboarding and conflict checks.
Article on reducing onboarding time for new clients from two weeks to five days.
Merged with a smaller firm and doubled its corporate team.
